title: Refund Fee Credit Computation Sheet, Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
Computation of the refund fee credit on a Pocketwire Business Profile.

**The refund and its sale.** The refund credited is the refund most recently booked on the profile, and its sale is the sale that refund points to. The refund amount and the refund date are those recorded on that refund; the sale amount and the sale date are those recorded on that sale.

**Percentage part.** The percentage part is the sale amount multiplied by the credited fee percentage, rounded to the nearest cent. No part of the fixed fee is credited.

**Refund percentage credit.** The refund percentage credit is the percentage part, worked out at the credited fee percentage, multiplied by the credited refund share, multiplied by the refund timing percentage and divided by one hundred. It is not rounded at this point.

**Refund fee credit.** The refund fee credit is the claim-settled refund credit, rounded to the nearest cent only at that last step.

**Plain case.** Credited at the tier's in-app and online-checkout transaction fee percentage on the refunded share — the refund amount divided by the sale amount — the credit is the percentage part, the sale amount multiplied by that percentage and rounded to the nearest cent, multiplied by the refunded share and rounded to the nearest cent, with no part of the fixed fee credited.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Sale USD 200.00; credited fee percentage 2.50%; refund USD 80.00, so a refunded share of 0.4; a credited refund share of 0.4, a refund timing percentage of 100 and a claim-settled refund credit equal to the refund percentage credit.

- Percentage part: 200.00 multiplied by 2.50% is USD 5.00.
- Refund percentage credit: 5.00 multiplied by 0.4, multiplied by 100 and divided by one hundred, is USD 2.00.
- Refund fee credit: USD 2.00.

With a sale of USD 123.45 at 2.50%, the percentage part is 3.08625, rounded to USD 3.09 before any share is applied.
